name: pour-it
description: Pour It — a physics-based liquid-pouring precision game.

scripts.android:add: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
